en: A colorized aerial view of a large yellow neoclassical theater complex and surrounding city blocks. The building has two main wings with green roofs, forming a curved frontage onto a tree‑lined square. Around it are streets, smaller buildings, and an open area crowded with people, carts and horses. The image is framed like an old printed postcard, with a white border and red caption text along the bottom.
